name: Harinezumi-jou Satsujin Jiken: Jo - Maboroshi o Miru Otoko no Hanashi-
original_name: 針鼠城殺人事件・序 -幻を瞰る男の話-
source:
On some day in July, five girls were found dismembered.  
Who killed them?
Apparently, it was the lord’s son, young Karel.  
This useless kid, who barely made it out of the basement on the best of his days, had ended up killing innocent girls.

The quiet town was startled by the series of killings.
Evidence pointed squarely at Karel Egel, the local nobleman’s son.  
He was well known for his unusual preferences, thus the cops came to him first but he himself maintained, “I don’t remember a thing.”  
Without a solid confession or proof, being a noble he could evade conviction even if guilty.

“Isn’t this just way too cruel to those dead poor girls?”

Stuck on that thought, Karel decided to gather evidence to prove his own guilt as well as plan his next steps.
He kicked off his independent investigation while playing a part of a pretty girl’s dog.  
First things first: he headed to the crime scene as any investigator would. 
But to his shock, he stumbled upon the severed head of victim number six! 

'Why were these girls killed? And am I really the one who did it?'

This is a story of struggle—a tale of kids who face setbacks yet still fight their way into adulthood.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100127180537/http://1945.namaste.jp/t]the official website[/url]]
translation:
七月的某一天，五名女孩被发现被肢解。
谁杀了他们？
显然，这是领主的儿子，年轻的卡雷尔。
这个无用的孩子，在他最好的日子里勉强从地下室出来，最终杀死了无辜的女孩。

安静的小镇被这一系列的杀戮震惊了。
证据直接指向当地贵族的儿子卡雷尔·埃格尔。
他以其不同寻常的喜好而闻名，因此警察首先找到了他，但他本人坚称，“我什么都不记得了。”  
如果没有确凿的供述或证据，作为贵族，即使有罪也可以逃避定罪。

“这对那些死去的可怜女孩来说是不是太残忍了？”

出于这个想法，卡雷尔决定收集证据来证明自己有罪，并计划下一步的行动。
他在扮演一位漂亮女孩的狗时开始了他的独立调查。
首先，他像任何调查员一样前往犯罪现场。
但令他震惊的是，他偶然发现了六号受害者的头颅！

“这些女孩为什么被杀？我真的是干这事的人吗？

这是一个奋斗的故事，一个孩子们面对挫折却仍奋力走向成年的故事。”

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100127180537/http://1945.namaste.jp/t]官方网站[/url]]
